mcc_registry_search_note: 18 MCC objectives were cited, of which 14 came from the scope packet's bounded candidate set (22-1, 22-2, 26, 49, 52, 6-1, 6-2, 16-1, 3-2, 3-3, 3-4, plus the pediatric/OBGYN-discipline duplicates not used) and 8 were found via targeted search-mcc-objectives full-registry searches beyond the packet's candidate set: 'chest pain' -> 14; 'abdominal mass' -> 1, 2; 'anemia' -> 42-1; 'weight loss' -> 118-2; 'preventive' -> 74; 'substance use' -> 103. Full-registry searches for 'gastroesophageal reflux', 'peptic ulcer', 'dyspepsia', 'inflammatory bowel disease' (phrase), 'irritable bowel', 'celiac', 'colorectal cancer', 'cancer screening', 'hepatitis', 'cirrhosis', 'pancreatitis', 'gallstones', 'cholecystitis', 'malabsorption', 'ascites', 'encephalopathy', 'polyp', 'diverticul', 'reflux', 'heartburn', and 'esophag' all returned zero direct-title matches, confirming a genuine MCC-objectives-registry coverage gap for these named GI diagnoses (each was instead mapped via its explicit appearance in a nearby presentation-based objective's own causal_conditions text, retrieved from research/mcc/objectives_registry.json - not model memory).
